newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ricardo sells non-auto design to mbo.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ricardo sells non-auto design to mbo.

text.p: British-based automotive and engineering designer and consultant Ricardo Group plc said on Friday it was selling its non-auto design division, with annual turnover of 28.6 million stg, to its managers and would be able to reduce group borrowings by 7.0 million stg as a consesquence.

"As a result of the disposal, Ricardo will take an exceptional charge of 2.6 million stg during the current financial year, reflecting the costs of the transaction and the discount of the sale price against net assets," Ricardo said.
It will write off goodwill of 13.6 million stg.

In addition to the disposal, Ricardo said it would also be restructuring some of its assets in the United States, leading to a 0.5 million stg cash outlay and further writedowns of assets taking the total revamp cost to about 2.5 million stg.

"The board considers it essential to maintain a significant US presence in order to maintain its ability to service international customers in (the) core ativity of automotive design and development engineering," the statement added.
Ricardo's profits from its core activities have grown sharply over the last five years and the company said that current trading in continuing activities remained in line with market expectations.
The Design unit's management buyout team will pay a cash consideration of 1.8 million stg as well as clearing bank debts and intra-group liabilities, and paying Ricardo a pre-sale dividend.
